name: avatar
description: Change your profile avatar image. Accepts base64-encoded PNG, JPEG, or WebP (max 256KB). The image is sanitized and resized to 128x128.

action.description: set: upload a new avatar (requires image field), reset: remove custom avatar, status: check if custom avatar is set.

image.description: Base64-encoded image data (PNG, JPEG, or WebP). Required for 'set' action.
